BootDisk.description: A [Persistent disk](https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/disks) used as the boot disk for a Compute Engine VM instance.

sizeGb.description: Optional. The size of the disk in gigabytes (GB), which must be at least 40 GB.

NetworkReference.description: A reference to a [VPC network](https://cloud.google.com/vpc/docs/vpc) in Google Compute Engine.

network.description: Output only. Name of the network, in the format `projects/{project}/global/networks/{network}`.

subnetwork.description: Output only. Name of the particular subnetwork being used by the cluster, in the format `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/subnetworks/{subnetwork}`.

nextPageToken.description: A token that can be sent as `page_token` to retrieve the next page. If this field is absent, there are no subsequent pages.

unreachable.description: Locations that could not be reached.

DeletePrivateServiceAccess.description: When set in OperationStep, indicates private service access deletion step.

Cluster.description: A collection of virtual machines and connected resources forming a high-performance computing cluster capable of running large-scale, tightly coupled workloads. A cluster combines a set a compute resources that perform computations, storage resources that contain inputs and store outputs, an orchestrator that is responsible for assigning jobs to compute resources, and network resources that connect everything together.

storageResources.description: Optional. Storage resources available to the cluster. Keys specify the ID of the storage resource by which it can be referenced elsewhere, and must conform to [RFC-1034](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc1034) (lower-case, alphanumeric, and at most 63 characters).

computeResources.description: Optional. Compute resources available to the cluster. Keys specify the ID of the compute resource by which it can be referenced elsewhere, and must conform to [RFC-1034](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc1034) (lower-case, alphanumeric, and at most 63 characters).

name.description: Identifier. [Relative resource name](https://google.aip.dev/122) of the cluster, in the format `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/clusters/{cluster}`.

updateTime.description: Output only. Time that the cluster was most recently updated.

description.description: Optional. A description for your cluster. You can use up to 2,048 characters.

labels.description: Optional. [Labels](https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/labeling-resources) applied to the cluster. Labels can be used to organize clusters and to filter them in queries.

createTime.description: Output only. Time that the cluster was originally created.

networkResources.description: Optional. Network resources available to the cluster. Must contain exactly one value. Keys specify the ID of the network resource by which it can be referenced elsewhere, and must conform to [RFC-1034](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc1034) (lower-case, alphanumeric, and at most 63 characters).

uid.description: Output only. The globally unique identifier for this Cluster.

orchestrator.description: Optional. Orchestrator that is responsible for scheduling and running jobs on the cluster.

reconciling.description: Output only. Indicates whether changes to the cluster are currently in flight. If this is `true`, then the current state might not match the cluster's intended state.

nodesets.description: Output only. Name of the nodeset to delete

DeleteNodeset.description: When set in OperationStep, indicates that a nodeset should be deleted.

UpdateLoginNode.description: When set in OperationStep, indicates that a login node should be updated.

UpdateOrchestrator.description: When set in OperationStep, indicates that an orchestrator should be updated.

unreachable.description: Unordered list. Unreachable resources. Populated when the request sets `ListOperationsRequest.return_partial_success` and reads across collections. For example, when attempting to list all resources across all supported locations.

operations.description: A list of operations that matches the specified filter in the request.

filestore.description: Output only. Name of the Filestore instance, in the format `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/instances/{instance}`

DeleteFilestoreInstance.description: When set in OperationStep, indicates that a Filestore instance should be deleted.

OperationMetadata.description: Represents the metadata of the long-running operation.

createTime.description: Output only. The time the operation was created.

target.description: Output only. Server-defined resource path for the target of the operation.

progress.description: Output only. Progress of the operation.

verb.description: Output only. Name of the verb executed by the operation.

requestedCancellation.description: Output only. Identifies whether the user has requested cancellation of the operation. Operations that have been cancelled successfully have google.longrunning.Operation.error value with a google.rpc.Status.code of `1`, corresponding to `Code.CANCELLED`.

endTime.description: Output only. The time the operation finished running.

apiVersion.description: Output only. API version used to start the operation.

quotaUser.description: Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.

fields.description: Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.

prettyPrint.description: Returns response with indentations and line breaks.

oauth_token.description: OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.

key.description: API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.

https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-pl.description: See, edit, configure, and delete your Google Cloud data and see the email address for your Google Account.
